From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver@acmether.com>, Sophie Ruiz <sophie.ruiz@acmether.com>

Subject: Commit guardrails & CS handback: Q3 expansion readiness

Team —

Sending the Q3 expansion snapshot for Acme ahead of our commit review. Finance asked that we firm up stage classifications and CS readiness before the Friday commit cut. I attached the workbook with the three line items we expect to surface in the forecast. Quick asks: 

- Kimberly / Markus: confirm the stage for each opportunity (Pipeline, Commit, Upside) and set the commit probability per the current deal playbook (I filled suggested %s in the sheet).
- CS (Grace): confirm the technical readiness and onboarding window for the deals marked as "near-term". Any red flags that would move a deal out of commit?
- Finance: if a deal needs to be held as upside pending procurement terms, note that in the spreadsheet under "finance_note" so we can reconcile in the forecast.

High level numbers in the sheet (row IDs 3/4/5): Acme Labs PO expansion ($185k ARR), Acme Therapeutics pilot upgrade ($95k ARR), and Lumen replacement add-on ($62k ARR). I flagged the pilot upgrade as "needs final SOW sign-off".

Please reply with a one-line stage confirmation and any lifting items by EOD Thu so we have time to update the commit workbook. If you'd prefer to triage live, I can block 15 minutes tomorrow morning.

Attachments: Q3_commit_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB), CS_playback_notes.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Commit guardrails & CS handback: Q3 expansion readiness

Monica, thanks for pulling this together — I skimmed the sheet and left two quick notes. One-line confirmations below: 

- Acme Labs PO expansion: Stage = Commit, probability = 85% (PO in legal review; procurement has confirmed budget).
- Acme Therapeutics pilot upgrade: Stage = Upside, probability = 40% (SOW outstanding; customer sign-off required).
- Lumen replacement add-on: Stage = Commit, probability = 70% (CS backlog alignment pending but shipment confirmed).

Note: Per finance guardrails, anything <50% should be labeled Upside unless there is a signed legal/PO. I'll update the "probability" column in the workbook.

If folks want, I'm available for a 15-min triage at 09:00 PT tomorrow — I'll send a calendar if that's helpful.

-Kim

Hi Monica / Kim / Grace —

Thanks for the detail. Quick answers from our side: 

- For the pilot upgrade (Acme Therapeutics), legal is reviewing the SOW today; procurement is aligned but we need to confirm final invoicing cadence. Expect sign-off by next Tue (8/25).
- For Acme Labs PO expansion, procurement has routed the PO to our finance team; no blockers.
- For Lumen replacement, we have one internal dependency: network team scheduling the replacement window (targeting week of 9/6).

We'd be fine with the pilot being marked as Upside for the commit if that helps your forecasting cadence — we'll aim to move it to Commit as soon as SOW is signed. Happy to jump on the 15-min slot if you schedule it.

Best,
Oliver Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Therapeutics
oliver@acmether.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit guardrails & CS handback: Q3 expansion readiness

Folks —

Thanks for the updates. Final finance stance after reviewing Kim's notes and the attached workbook: 

- Acme Labs PO expansion: Accept as Commit at 85% probability. Finance will include $157.25k (85% of $185k) in the conservative commit column for the Friday close.
- Acme Therapeutics pilot upgrade: Mark as Upside (40%) — do NOT include in the committed baseline. We will keep a line for management visibility but exclude from conservative numbers until SOW is executed.
- Lumen replacement add-on: Accept as Commit at 70% probability; include $43.4k in the committed baseline.

Action items: 
- Monica: update HubSpot record (ACME-12345) with the agreed staging and add Oliver's note about SOW timing.
- Grace: please confirm onboarding ETA once network scheduling is final so we can convert from forecast to expected recognized timing.

If anyone wants to escalate any of these (credit, SLA exceptions, or contract timing) loop me in and I can fast-track with Finance.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Finance Operations
